AspectRatioHelp: The ratio the frame is cropped to, such as 16:9.
AvoidMediaSegmentsHelp: Take no frame from inside the media segments ticked below. Segments come from a media segment provider, so an item without any is unaffected.
BloomColorHelp: The color pooled in the middle of the frame.
BrightenFrameHelp: How much every extracted frame is brightened.
CanvasSourceHelp: Determine where the poster background should come from.
ColorSourceHelp: Where the letter color comes from.
ConfirmDeleteFont: Delete {0}? Designs that use {1} {2} draw with the next font of that name.
ConfirmRemoveDesignUsed: Remove {0}? Its images in {1} use the default design.
ConfirmRemoveLogoDesignUsed: Remove {0}? Its logos in {1} use the default design.
ConfirmRemoveProfile: Remove {0}? Its assigned items use the default profile.
CustomRegexHelp: Anything matching this regular expression is removed.
CutoutBorderHelp: Draw a contrasting outline around the cut-out shape.
CutoutTypeHelp: Show the episode as a code like S01E01 or as a word like ONE.
ElementSpacingHelp: Gap between stacked elements, as a percent of the short side.
EmptyFoundCollections: No collections found. Make sure you have collections in your Jellyfin library.
EmptyFoundFolders: No folders found. Make sure you have folders in a mixed content or home videos library.
EmptyFoundMovies: No movies found. Make sure you have movies in your Jellyfin library.
EmptyFoundSeries: No series found. Make sure you have TV series in your Jellyfin library.
EmptyFoundVideos: No videos found. Make sure you have music videos or home videos in your Jellyfin library.
EnableLetterboxDetectionHelp: Detect and crop black bars from the frame first.
ErrorDefaultDesignNameReserved: Default is reserved for the default design.
ErrorDefaultNameReserved: Default is reserved for the default profile.
ErrorDesignNameTaken: A design with this name already exists.
ErrorFontExtension: Only .ttf and .otf fonts can be uploaded.
ErrorFontName: The font name is not allowed.
ErrorFontNotDeleted: The font could not be deleted.
ErrorFontNotSaved: The font could not be saved.
ErrorFontTooLarge: The font is larger than 20 MB.
ErrorFontUnreadable: The font could not be read.
ErrorImportFile: Could not import the file. Select a design template in JSON.
ErrorImportNoSettings: Could not import the file, since it holds no design settings.
ErrorKeepOneLogoDesign: Keep at least one logo design. Turn logos off in a profile instead.
ErrorLoadDesigns: Could not load the designs. Reload the page.
ErrorLoadLogoDesigns: Could not load the logo designs. Reload the page.
ErrorLoadProfiles: Could not load the profiles. Reload the page.
ErrorLoadSettings: Could not load the settings. Reload the page.
ErrorLoadUploadedFonts: Could not load the uploaded fonts. Reload the page.
ErrorLogoDesignNameTaken: A logo design with this name already exists.
ErrorLogoDesignRequired: At least one logo design is required.
ErrorLogoPreview: Could not draw the logo preview.
ErrorNotAFont: The file is not a TrueType or OpenType font.
ErrorProfileNameTaken: A profile with this name already exists.
ErrorProfileUnassigned: Could not save, since {0} has nothing assigned. Assign items or remove the profile.
ErrorSaveLogoDesigns: Could not save the logo designs.
ExtractWindowEndHelp: How far into each episode extraction stops.
ExtractWindowStartHelp: How far into each episode extraction begins.
FadeColorHelp: The color that fades in from one side of the frame.
FillHelp: What the letters are filled with.
GraphicAlignmentHelp: Which side the graphic is pulled to.
GraphicPathHelp: A graphic drawn above the image and below the text.
GraphicPositionHelp: Where the graphic sits, top to bottom.
GraphicSizeHelp: Size of the graphic as a percent of the short side.
GridFramesHelp: How many frames the grid holds.
GridGapHelp: Space between the frames, as a percent of the short side.
HeaderAssignedItemsNote: Pick the items this profile draws. Anything not picked uses the default profile.
HeaderFontsNote: The bundled fonts are always available, and uploaded .ttf and .otf fonts join them in every font list.
HeaderFrameExtractionNote: How frames are taken from a video and cleaned up, for every poster and every backdrop.
HeaderImagesNote: Pick which images each kind of item gets and the designs they use. A second and third design add choices to Edit Images.
HeaderSettingsNote: Artwork Generator is turned on per library, under Image Fetchers in that library's settings. Profiles decide which images it makes.
HeightHelp: The room the lettering gets. The finished logo is trimmed to its artwork.
HelpAspectRatios: The shape each image is cropped to, such as 16:9 for landscape and 2:3 for portrait.
HelpDropFonts: Drop .ttf or .otf fonts here or click to select.
HelpFixedFrameSeed: Any whole number makes frame choice repeatable, so an item always gets the same frames. Empty picks new ones each refresh.
HelpGradientEndColor: ARGB hex color for the gradient end.
HelpGradientEndOpacity: Opacity of the gradient end, drawn as a darker shade of the same dominant color.
HelpImageCacheMinutes: How long the choices rendered for Edit Images stay available, 5 to 1440. Until then, reopening the dialog or switching image type shows the same choices instead of rendering new ones.
HelpImageChoiceCount: Choices offered per image type in Edit Images. Each is a different frame, so a higher number is slower to open.
HelpLogoTextOpacity: How solid the sampled color is drawn. The color itself comes from the item's own artwork, and this color is only used if that artwork cannot be read.
HelpOverlayColor: ARGB hex color for the overlay.
HelpOverlayOpacity: How strongly the episode's dominant color tints the poster. The color itself comes from the image.
HelpPortraitRatioOnly: Portrait images always crop to the portrait ratio. Landscape images keep the frame's own shape.
HelpSampleName: The name the preview draws. It is not saved.
HelpSampledFromBackdrop: The color is sampled from this backdrop.
HelpSampledFromPoster: The color is sampled from this poster.
HelpSubtitleColor: ARGB hex color for the subtitle.
HelpTextColor: ARGB hex color for the text.
HelpTitleColor: ARGB hex color for the title text.
HideRepeatedSubtitleHelp: Drop the subtitle when it says the same thing as the title.
LabelLoneSubtitleTakesTheTitleEdge: Lone Subtitle Takes the Title Edge
LetterboxBlackThresholdHelp: Brightness below which a pixel counts as black.
LetterboxConfidenceHelp: Percent of pixels that must be black to count as letterboxing.
LogoAlignmentHelp: Horizontal alignment of the logo on the poster.
LogoHeightHelp: Logo height as a percent of the poster's short side, 1 to 100.
LogoPositionHelp: Vertical position of the logo on the poster.
LoneLineFollowsTitleHelp: An item with no title puts its subtitle on the title edge.
LongSubtitleHandlingHelp: What to do when the subtitle does not fit.
LongTextHandlingHelp: What to do when the title does not fit.
MaxLinesHelp: The most lines a name may wrap onto.
MaximumSamplesPerVideoHelp: The most frames scored from one video in one go, 1 to 64. It caps how long a film with many choices takes.
MinimumSamplesPerVideoHelp: The fewest frames scored from a film, video, or episode on its own, 1 to 64, so even a single image is chosen from several. A series, season, collection, or folder compares its videos' frames with each other instead, so it is not held to this.
NoteImageNotShown: Jellyfin clients do not show this image for {0}.
NoteStyleNoLandscape: This style cannot lay out landscape images, so those are drawn with Standard instead.
NoteStyleNoPortrait: This style cannot lay out portrait images, so those are drawn with Standard instead.
NoteStyleNoShapes: This style cannot lay out landscape or portrait images, so those are drawn with Standard instead.
OptionTopLeftCornerToBottomRightCorner: Top Left Corner to Bottom Right Corner
OptionTopRightCornerToBottomLeftCorner: Top Right Corner to Bottom Left Corner
OutlineWidthHelp: Stroke width as a percent of the font size.
OverlayGradientHelp: Gradient direction from the overlay color to the secondary color.
PaletteDerivedColorsHelp: Take the overlay colors from each image.
ParallelExtractionsHelp: How many frames are extracted at once, 1 to 8. Higher is faster on local storage. Lower it on slow network storage.
PinstripeColorHelp: The color of the stripes running along the sash.
PlaceholderDesignDescription: Bold titles over a dark fade
PosterFillHelp: How the image is resized to fit the poster.
PosterSafeAreaHelp: Margin kept clear around all edges, as a percent of the short side.
PrimaryFontFamilyHelp: Font family for the title text.
PrimaryFontSizeHelp: Title size as a percent of the poster's short side, 1 to 100.
PrimaryFontStyleHelp: Font style for the title text.
ReuseSamplesHelp: Let an item's poster, thumb, backdrop, and logo draw from overlapping frames. Off gives every image type its own frames, at the cost of extracting more.
RimColorHelp: The color the bloom fades out to at the edges.
SamplesPerFrameHelp: How many frames are scored for each one kept, 1 to 8. Higher picks better frames but takes longer, since every sample is its own extraction. 1 keeps every frame it takes, with no choosing.
SecondaryFontPathHelp: Path to a TTF, OTF, or TTC font file readable by the server.
SecondaryFontSizeHelp: Text size as a percent of the poster's short side, 1 to 100.
SecondarySizeHelp: The small line's size as a percent of the large one.
SecondaryUseCustomFontHelp: Use a font file instead of a built in font.
ShowPrimaryHelp: Draw the title, the larger line.
ShowSecondaryHelp: Draw the subtitle, the smaller line.
StripYearHelp: Remove a year in brackets, such as (2019).
StyleBloomDescription: A soft bloom of color in the center with the text set over it.
StyleBloomSubtitleHelp: The subtitle is the episode code, centered over the bloom just above the title.
StyleBloomTitleHelp: The title is the item's own name, centered over the bloom.
StyleBrushDescription: Brush strokes reveal the image through a flat overlay. Painted, editorial look.
StyleBrushSubtitleHelp: The subtitle is the episode code, set on the left just above the title.
StyleBrushTitleHelp: The title is the item's own name, set left aligned at the foot of the image over the brush strokes.
StyleCutoutDescription: Large text cut out of the image. Bold and minimal.
StyleCutoutSubtitleHelp: The subtitle is the episode number or code, and this style cuts it out of the image rather than drawing it as a line of text.
StyleCutoutTitleHelp: The title is the item's own name, set below the cutout, and it becomes the cutout itself when the item has no number to cut.
StyleFadeDescription: One sided fade with a big number and a vertical title. Editorial and bold.
StyleFadeSubtitleHelp: The subtitle is the item's number, drawn as the big number at the foot of the image.
StyleFadeTitleHelp: The title is the item's own name, set sideways so it runs up the edge of the image.
StyleFrameDescription: Image inside a decorative border. Polished gallery look.
StyleFrameSubtitleHelp: The subtitle is the episode code, set into whichever border edge the title does not take.
StyleFrameTitleHelp: The title is the item's own name, set into the top or bottom edge of the border.
StyleFrostedGlassDescription: Text on a frosted glass panel that blurs the image behind it.
StyleFrostedGlassSubtitleHelp: The subtitle is the episode code, centered on the panel above the title.
StyleFrostedGlassTitleHelp: The title is the item's own name, centered on the frosted panel.
StyleLogoDescription: The item's logo over the image. Puts branding first.
StyleLogoSubtitleHelp: The subtitle is the episode code, set on the line above the title.
StyleLogoTitleHelp: The title is the item's own name, set at the bottom under the logo.
StyleNumeralDescription: Large Roman numeral as the focal element. Minimal and distinctive.
StyleNumeralSubtitleHelp: The subtitle is the item's number, drawn as the large Roman numeral rather than as a line of text.
StyleNumeralTitleHelp: The title is the item's own name, set under the numeral, and it takes the numeral's place when the item has no number.
StyleSplitDescription: Series poster beside the frame with text. Magazine layout.
StyleSplitSubtitleHelp: The subtitle is an episode's numbers, a season's label, or a film's year, set above the title in that panel.
StyleSplitTitleHelp: The title is the item's own name, set at the bottom of the panel beside the frame.
StyleStandardDescription: Full frame image with text at the bottom. Clean and versatile.
StyleStripedDescription: Tilted pinstriped sash carrying the title, with the subtitle in the corner. Sporty and graphic.
StyleStripedSubtitleHelp: The subtitle is the episode code, set in the corner, or on the sash itself when there is no title.
StyleStripedTitleHelp: The title is the item's own name, set along the tilted sash.
StyleSubtitleHelp: The subtitle is an episode's numbers, a season's label, or a film's year, set above the title.
StyleTimelineDescription: Progress bar with the subtitle, the position, and an optional title. Clean and data driven.
StyleTimelineSubtitleHelp: The subtitle is the episode code beside the bar, marking where the episode falls in its season.
StyleTimelineTitleHelp: The title is the item's own name, set left aligned above the progress bar.
StyleTitleHelp: The title is the item's own name, set at the bottom of the image under the subtitle.
SubtitleModeHelp: How to treat a name split by a colon or dash.
TextAlignmentHelp: Which side the title and subtitle are pulled to.
TextPositionHelp: Where the title and subtitle sit.
TitleEdgeHelp: Which edge of the border the title takes. The subtitle takes the other one.
ToastDesignImported: {0} imported. Select Save to keep it.
ToastDesignImportedBy: {0} by {1} imported. Select Save to keep it.
UseCustomFontHelp: Use a font file instead of an installed font.
VideosPerParentHelp: Most videos a series, season, collection, or folder takes frames from, or 0 for all. Lower is faster on network storage.
WidthHelp: The width of the space the lettering is laid out in.
